{{Quote|Civilization has gotten confused while I was away.|Lak Sivrak|<ref name="G1" />}}
'''Lak Sivrak,''' sometimes known only as '''Sivrak,''' was a [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] who sometimes worked for the [[Uvena System Constabulary]]. Sivrak obtained fame working for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], unaware of the tyranny of his employers. Sivrak then found a hidden settlement of members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and, lacking political convictions, decided to help them. He discovered their status as fugitives and swore not to report them. However, the Empire found the settlement nonetheless and discovered that Sivrak had not reported it. Sivrak became a fugitive of the Empire, and was forced to hide from the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].

Sivrak visited the local [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] and there he met [[Dice Ibegon/Legends|Dice Ibegon]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Lamproid/Legends|Florn Lamproid]] that convinced him to join the Alliance with her. Ibegon and Sivrak became lovers and fought the Empire together. While the Shistavanen had initially followed her only to court her, Sivrak became a proud Rebel warrior, fierce opponent of the Empire and member of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]]. Ibegon [[Death/Legends|died]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], and a heartbroken Sivrak kept on fighting, honoring her last wish.

Sivrak was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. His [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was damaged beyond repair and his death could be imminent. It was then that Dice Ibegon contacted him again, using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to give him a last chance: He could rewrite history, turning his back to the Alliance when he had first met Ibegon in the cantina, knowing that he would have to suffer and die otherwise. Sivrak chose to stay with his beloved, and joined her as a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] after his heroic death at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].

==Biography==
===The scout===
[[File:LakSivrakEGC.jpg|thumb|left|Lak Sivrak]]
{{Quote|I believe only in the hunt.|Lak Sivrak|<ref name="OL" />}}
Lak Sivrak was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] of the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], born in one of the planets in the Shistavanen-controlled<ref name="EC" /> [[Uvena system/Legends|Uvena system]].<ref name="AI" /> He had a brother, [[Tagg Sivrak]].<ref name="EA" /> At some point, Lak Sivrak heard about the sentient species known as [[Lamproid/Legends|Florn Lamproids]], discovering that they were the only intelligent beings in a planet full of threats.<ref name="OL" />

Lak Sivrak became an expert<ref name="TOY">''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]''</ref> [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and tracker,<ref name="EC" /> like many other Shistavanens from Uvena. Sivrak was employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="F2">{{FactFile|22|CAN 1-6|Mos Eisley Cantina Characters}}</ref> to chart several dangerous territories in the galaxy.<ref name="EC" /><ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> Sivrak proved to be an enterprising, profitable professional and one of the best scouts in the Empire.<ref name="EC" /> This Imperial world scout<ref name="TOY" /> obtained notoriety among his peers.<ref name="EC" /><ref name="AI" />

At some time before [[8 BBY/Legends|8 BBY]], the [[Uvena System Constabulary]] approached Sivrak and asked for his help in the search for the missing Shistavanen [[Alpha Premier]] [[Korta Sarc]]. Sivrak worked in this task along with another Shistavanen scout, [[Yurdak Fav]]. Sivrak and Fav found a murdered Sac at the [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] embassy, and from that point on they were relieved of this task. Sivrak then spent a time with Fav and other scouts and concluded that Fav was essentially a good being. After this, Sivrak returned to his home warren.<ref name="AI" />

Sivrak spent a lot of time scouting the galaxy, having little to no contact with the civilization.<ref name="EC" /><ref name="G1" /> He was unaware of the tyranny of his employers,<ref name="AI" /> or of the fact that an organized anti-Imperial [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] even existed.<ref name="EC" /> Sivrak believed that all politicians were bureaucrats of similar morality, and he was content simply by not dealing directly with them.<ref name="G1" />

While he was probing the space,<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" /> he accidentally discovered a secret settlement on a rocky moon. It was a [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] affiliated with the Alliance,<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" /><ref name="EC" /> populated by families of Imperial fugitives and refugees from planets that the Empire had razed, including [[Dalron Five]]<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" /> and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="G1" /> Sivrak believed they were survivors of a crash<ref name="MT" /> or mere settlers, and he offered to help them preparing for the winter. The Rebels were suspicious, but Sivrak convinced them of his good intentions<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" /> and helped them.<ref name="EC" /> During dinner and bonfire meetings, the Rebels told Sivrak<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" /> about the tyranny<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" /> and atrocities of the Empire,<ref name="EC" /> and about the pride the Rebels felt.<ref name="MT" /> Eventually, Sivrak decided to leave the colony,<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" /> and swore his new friends<ref name="EC" /> that he would not betray their secret home. True to his word, Sivrak traveled to a different [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and quickly wrote down a report for the Empire,<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" /> explictly saying that the rocky moon was lifeless.<ref name="EC" />

The Empire nonetheless hired a [[Unidentified Imperial scout|second scout]] to charter places that Sivrak might have missed.<ref name="G1" /> This person found the Rebel colony and reported it to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" /><ref name="EC" /> The colony was evacuated,<ref name="G1" /> thanks to a warning by Rebel spies,<ref name="MT" /> but the Empire captured several prisoners and questioned them<ref name="G1" /> with thorough methods<ref name="MT" /> One [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] Rebel<ref name="EC" /> revealed that Sivrak had visited the colony several months before this event.<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" />

The Empire began looking for Sivrak, under charges of hiding the presence of a Rebel safe world in a system he had discovered.<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" /><ref name="EC" /> They started by freezing Sivrak's accounts,<ref name="G1" /> and then they sent [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] after Sivrak.<ref name="EC" /> Sivrak's first notification of the Empire disliking him was when<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" /> he had to [[Blaster/Legends|blast]] these stormtroopers.<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" /><ref name="EC" /> However, he was still unaware of the reasons why the Empire had betrayed him.<ref name="G1" />

===The fugitive===
{{Quote|Sivrak is an ideal candidate for recruitment by the Alliance, but his own fear of discovery and his previously close ties to the Empire have made him hesitant.|Voren Na'al|<ref name="G1" />}}
Suddenly deciding that he was aghast at the horrors the Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] performed, Sivrak deserted.<ref name="F2" /> Dropping his first name<ref name="EC" /> to change his identity,<ref name="G1" /> he intended to hide at a different point of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" /> The Imperial forces chased him, prompting him to reach the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="AI" /> and he eventually escaped to the local [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]],<ref name="EC" /> soon before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="MT" /> Low on money, Sivrak considered helping the Alliance in exchange for money, but he did not know how he could contact them.<ref name="EC" />

[[File:Hive_of_Scum_and_Villainy.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Sivrak in Chalmun's Cantina as Luke Skywalker enters]]
Sivrak noticed that the Empire had a presence in Mos Eisley, particularly in the form of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="OL" /> He also discovered that many locals were information brokers who would sell him to the Empire should they discover his identity.<ref name="EC" /> As such, the newcomer Sivrak chose to speak with very few people,<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" /><ref name="EC" /> to the chagrin of these information brokers.<ref name="G1" /> This led many to conjecture about the mysterious individual known only as Sivrak,<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" /> and nicknamed "the wolfman".<ref name="F2" />
The locals correctly assumed that Sivrak came from the Uvena system,<ref name="G1" /> and the notched<ref name="MT" /> [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] slung over his back suggested them that he was a scout.<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" /> However, they erroneously believed that Sivrak was only trying to start his career when the Empire began to exact punishment for unauthorized exploration<ref name="G1" /> and restrictions scouting of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], causing the wolfman to be unemployed.<ref name="MT" />

Lak Sivrak, with [[Boot/Legends|boots]] heavy due to dust and sweating due to the heat of the twin suns, decided to enter a local business where he had never been before, [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]. He wiped his paw agains this mouth while his eyes adjusted to the change of lighting.<ref name="OL" /> Sivrak sat down to drink alone,<ref name="NL">{{StoryCite|story=Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> but he expected to make some business.<ref name="TOY" />

In fact, the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] official [[Feltipern Trevagg/Legends|Feltipern Trevagg]] was also at the cantina, looking for an amateur [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] to kill his assistant [[Balu]]. Trevagg believed that Sivrak was fierce and big enough to do the job, unlike other candidates such as weakling [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] or excesively dangerous [[Dannik Jerriko]]. However, Trevagg did not approach Sivrak at this point because the Gotal was busy courting [[M'iiyoom Onith/Legends|M'iiyoom Onith]].<ref name="NL" />

A running [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] scuttled past Sivrak. The Shistavanen then looked behind the bar and saw the [[Snake/Legends|snake]]-like female [[Dice Ibegon/Legends|Dice Ibegon]],<ref name="OL" /> a mysterious Florn Lamproid.<ref name="TOY" /> Sivrak perceived Ibegon's sex through her [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]], she then turned to him and seductively offered to buy him a drink, using the [[Shistavanen (language)|Shistavanen]]. Feeling a rise in temperature<ref name="OL" /> at meeting her,<ref name="EC" /><ref name="F2" /> Sivrak partially undressed and sat next to her. Ibegon shared a drop of her [[Bantha-blood fizz/Legends|bantha-blood]] with Sivrak, putting it in his muzzle with her tail. Sivrak used all of his social skills to impress her with romantic words in an attempt to seduce her. When she expressed sympathies for the Alliance, Sivrak expressed support for this view just to be with her.<ref name="OL" /> Soon, they were embracing, but they interrupted the act when perceiving a nearby fight between the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] thug [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]] and a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-welding [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|old man]]. Sivrak thought that local Imperial authorities would soon be at the cantina to investigate and, not wanting to be spotted by those, decided to leave. Ibegon went with him.<ref name="EC" />

[[File:Lak_Sivrak_DC.png|thumb|left|250px|Sivrak slips out the back of Chalmun's Cantina]]
Meanwhile, Trevagg was considering to hire Greedo as his minion, but Greedo was killed by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] only minutes after Sivrak's leaving. Seeing that, Trevagg looked for Sivrak, and was disappointed when he couldn't find the Shistavanen.<ref name="NL" />

Ibegon and Sivrak talked about the Alliance that night and many times during the following nights. Sivrak's desire to help the Alliance became stronger.<ref name="EC" /> Ibegon quickly felt in passionate love with Sivrak, noticing that his ideas were like hers.<ref name="F2" />

Ibegon<ref name="F2" /> and Sivrak returned to Chalmun's cantina later, becoming usual customers. The barman, [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]], was used to serve Sivrak a mug of crushed [[Gilden]], with its organ tendrils still writhing to attest their freshness.<ref name="OL" /> Sivrak met the [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] [[Myo/Legends|Myo]] several times during his time in Mos Eisley, more commonly at the cantina. The Shistavanen decided that Myo was quite a friendly being.<ref name="AI" />

After the Battle of Yavin, Rebel historian [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] made a research on Sivrak and, after a careful analysis through the Alliance data banks, discovered Sivrak's past help to the Alliance.<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" /> Na'al considered Sivrak to be a good potential recruit who was only scared because of his past relation to the Empire&mdash;even if he was short of money. Na'al suggested sending recruiters that Sivrak could bind with, including other scouts and kids akin to those living on the rocky moon colony.<ref name="G1" />

===The Rebel===
{{Quote|I have sworn allegiance to the Princess and the return of the Republic."<br />"You never meant to wear the uniform of a Rebel. That day in the cantina, when we first met, you only accepted my offer to join the Alliance as a way to wrap yourself in my coils.|Lak Sivrak and Dice Ibegon|<ref name="OL" />}}
Lak Sivrak helped several agents of the Alliance while on Mos Eisley without joining the Alliance himself.<ref name="MT" /> Eventually, around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="EC" /> a group of Rebels<ref name="AI" /> recruited him<ref name="EC" /><ref name="MT" /><ref name="AI" /> and Ibegon<ref name="F2" /> for the Alliance armed forces.<ref name="TOY" />

During his first few months in the Alliance, Sivrak provided important information on Imperial scouting procedures,<ref name="AI" /> served in several battles<ref name="MT" /> and became a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. He also joined the [[Task Force on Alliance Security]], an [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] group that compiled information on important threats for the Alliance. In this task, he provided addenda to the report on Yurdak Fav, who was disrupting Alliance activities, and on Myo, who had joined the Alliance-opposing [[Galactic Outdoor Survival School/Legends|Galactic Outdoor Survival School]]. Sivrak believed that both of them were not really evil and that they should be captured, questioned, and maybe even recruited.<ref name="AI" />

While he had initially been reluctant to join the Alliance, in time he became proud of his service as a warrior,<ref name="OL" /> and made Ibegon his female companion.<ref name="CD">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Dice Ibegon}}</ref> He talked with other Rebels and became familiar with stories about Imperial [[biogeneticist]]s taking Rebel corpses to [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] parts and keep them alive for research or entertainment. The Alliance also gave him a [[medkit]] adapted to the biology of his species.<ref name="OL" />

The Empire was still looking for Sivrak, knowing that Sivrak had become a Rebel scout. A squad of stormtroopers<ref name="WW">{{InsiderCite|59|Who's Who in Rogue Squadron}}</ref> tried to capture a different Shistavanen, [[Riv Shiel]], believing him to be Sivrak.<ref name="XW">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> Shiel had to kill the stormtroopers, earning his own [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]].<ref name="WW" /><ref name="XW" />

Sivrak, by then considered a Rebel grunt,<ref name="NGW">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> and Ibegon had been assigned to [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]],<ref name="OL" /> on the frozen planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> They fought in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]],<ref name="TOY" /> where Sivrak was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="OL" /> During the attack, Sivrak felt hope when the Rebel [[1.4 FD P-Tower/Legends|1.4 FD P-Tower]] antivehicle artillery blasted an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]], and then hopelessness when the AT-AT armor absorbed the shot.<ref name="NGW" />

Eventually leaving his vehicle, Sivrak ran through the trenches during the battle, tracking Ibegon through scent. He found her bleeding, fatally wounded, on the snow. Ignoring direct orders, Sivrak fell next to her, wanting to [[Death/Legends|die]] with her.<ref name="OL" /> With her last words, Ibegon asked Sivrak to keep on fighting Empire and to believe in the power of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="OL" /><ref name="EC" /> Sivrak agreed to do it because she had asked him, but Ibegon told him that it was his only option. She blessed Sivrak, eager to stay with him forever,<ref name="OL" /> and then died.<ref name="EC" /><ref name="OL" /><ref name="F2" /> A [[Human/Legends|Human]] Rebel prompted Sivrak to the evacuation point, but the grieving Sivrak snarled at him and, once the Human had gone, Sivrak gave Ibegon a funeral pyre with his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to prevent Imperial scientists from defiling her corpse. He also said her the words "May the Force be with you".<ref name="OL" />

===The sacrifice===
{{Quote|I don't want to leave you.''"<br />"''Knowing all that you know? Knowing with certainty what lies ahead?''"<br />"''Sometimes choice is an illusion.|Lak Sivrak and Dice Ibegon|<ref name="OL" />}}
By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Lak Sivrak was an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-Wing]] pilot<ref name="EC" /> under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] of the Alliance. He joined the Rebel [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] for an attack against the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]<ref name="OL" /> during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TOY" /> He, like many other Rebels, was briefed about the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] spies having confirmed that the Death Star was unfinished, but during the battle this information proved to be false. Sivrak believed that the battle had been lost because of this, and he started dodging enemy starships before even evasive maneuvers were ordered. He noticed the Imperial fleet approaching sector 47, but the Imperial [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] were static, as if they assumed Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were enough to deal with the Rebel attackers.<ref name="OL" />

The Rebel command ordered the starfighters to protect the fleet even if it cost them their lives. Sivrak believed that his life meant little without Ibegon, and as such he did not fear his own death. He sent his X-Wing in a collision course with three enemy [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], which prevented him from helping a [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] under attack. The TIEs confronted Sivrak, who roared against them crying the name of his beloved. Sivrak destroyed one of the TIEs, but his X-Wing was<ref name="OL" /> fatally<ref name="EC" /> damaged by them, and then he had a vision: Sivrak felt he was entering Chalmun's cantina for the very first time, reliving the moment where he first met Ibegon; however, the Shistavanen did had flashforwards of future events. He tried to question Ibegon about that, accusing her of using the Force while at the same time denying its existence.<ref name="OL" />

Sivrak's senses returned to the Battle of Endor, but the confused Shistavanen first tried to look for Ibegon in his canopy. Assuming that he had had a hallucination, Sivrak felt his X-Wing falling to the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of Endor, even after all of his efforts. Through his communicator, he discovered that [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] commando team had failed to destroy the Imperial bunker with the force-field generator protecting the Death Star. Sivrak considered his two alternatives: He could either direct the ship to a crash-land in the forests, where he could survive and became again a hunter and a tracker, no longer chased by the Empire, or alternatively ram the Imperial bunker in a suicide attack that could succeed where Solo had failed, should he could avoid the land defenses. In his briefing, Sivrak had been told that such an idea had a one-in-one-million probabilities of success.<ref name="OL" />

Sivrak's meditaitons were interrupted by the two surviving TIE fighters, that attacked him. The Shistavanen veered his ship and dropped all the available [[Mine/Legends|mines]] and decoys, then turned to face any surviving enemy. He confirmed that one of the TIEs had been destroyed, then had vivid memories of Ibegon's death on Hoth, and then saw the last TIE fighter blindedly shooting at him. This surprised Sivrak, but he could avoid the attack and bring it down. Then, he felt the local [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] bringing the vehicle to the point of no return.<ref name="OL" />

During these last seconds, Sivrak had a vision of a desert Chalmun's cantina where Ibegon reported [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] death. The Shistavanen noticed that Ibegon had died before Jabba did, and this changed the scenario to their first meeting once again. Sivrak understood that, using the power of the Force, Ibegon was giving her lover an alternative, a way out: Sivrak could leave the cantina alone, instead of going with Ibegon, and then he would be spared from a life of sacrifice for the Alliance, and from the loss of a lover. This was a choice that Ibegon made because she loved Sivrak. Sivrak, who also loved Ibegon, chose to embrace the Florn Lamproid once again, knowing how it would end.<ref name="OL" />

Deciding that sometimes choice is an illusion, Sivrak sent his ship to ram the shield generator. Only too late he discovered that General Solo had already destroyed it, but he could no longer change course. Sivrak's starship collided on the moon's surface.<ref name="OL" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|We are luminous beings, and always have been. True love can never be denied.|Dice Ibegon to Lak Sivrak|<ref name="OL" />}}
The survivors of the Battle of Endor held a victory party along with the local species, the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]. During it, a ghost-like, semi-transparent, bright [[Force ghost/Legends|Force spirit]] of Lak Sivrak met Dice Ibegon's. They joined, paw in tail, and walked to meet [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|three]] [[Yoda/Legends|other]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|friends]] that were waiting for them.<ref name="OL" /> Ibegon and Sivrak were together again, their spirits shining in the Force.<ref name="EC" />

Lak Sivrak was listed as dead during the Battle of Endor,<ref name="MT" /><ref name="EC" /><ref name="F2" /> having crashed on the moon after destroying several TIE fighters.<ref name="EC" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|What you must do is believe in the Force."<br />"If you wish me to.|Dice Ibegon and Lak Sivrak|<ref name="OL" />}}
Lak Sivrak was a furry, [[Meter/Legends|1.82-meter]] Shistavanen. Like others of his species, he had sensitive but powerful fangs and a rough-rasped tonge hidden in a canine muzzle. His nostrils flared when detecting a particular scent, specially fresh blood or smoke, and he had a full-throated voice that he could use to shout a battle cry or to snarl. His bright,<ref name="OL" /> red<ref name="EC" /> [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] perceived a greater wavelenght than a Human's&mdash;but less than a Lamproid's&mdash; and needed time to adjust to a change of lighting.<ref name="OL" /> He also had upright<ref name="ANH" /> ears that could recognize the voice of several species even if filtered through an intercom, or the music of the [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Modal Nodes]]. His hands ended in manipulative paws and, while he sometimes used boots,<ref name="OL" /> his feet were strong enough to not require those.<ref name="G1" /> Sivrak was known to howl at challenges and to face death&mdash;specially if he could perceive it as a hunter's death&mdash;with primal rage that were common to Shistavanen Wolfpeople.<ref name="OL" />

Behavior-wise, Sivrak was a typical Shistavanen male: Not aggressive, but ferocious,<ref name="CS">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Shistavanen Wolfman}}</ref> and clearly ferocious-looking by other species.<ref name="NL" /> Although his trust was hard to obtain, Sivrak was known to be very loyal.<ref name="G1" /> As a Rebel soldier, he ignored direct orders to stay with his dying female companion, and he was not beyond snarling at a fellow to scare him away.<ref name="OL" />

Ambitious and hard-working,<ref name="EC" /> Sivrak was an excellent scout, tracker and warrior,<ref name="AI" /> with important skills that he honed during his time in the Alliance.<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" /> He had specialized knowledge about planetary systems, alien species and survival, and was a qualified navigator and pilot.<ref name="G1" /> His weapons of choice were the [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], the [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and the [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]],<ref name="EC" /> and he commonly carried survival gear with him.<ref name="MT" /> During his time as an Imperial scout, Sivrak used the idiom "moving forward" when he felt the need to change location.<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" />

Sivrak was not a firm believer in the power of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], even after he had promised Ibegon to believe. When he first had a vision during the Battle of Endor, he dismissed it as a hallucination. However, before the end of the Battle, he had became a believer.<ref name="OL" />

===Relationships===
====Dice Ibegon====
{{Quote|That's not what you said when we first met here. You were most eloquent then, my romantic Wolfman.|Dice Ibegon|<ref name="OL" />}}
Lak Sivrak's relationship with Dice Ibegon began as a hormonal release: He was first impressed by the female pheromones she exhuded, and then admired the twists of her muscular coils. Being familiar with Florn Lamproids by that point, Sivrak knew that Ibegon's snake-like body was very strong, able to constrict the skull of a [[Bantha/Legends|Bantha]] until it crushed. Sivrak also liked Ibegon's light sensor and her mouth full of needle-like teeth.<ref name="OL" />

This eventually became true love. After her death, Sivrak was unable to forget her. His life had no longer a meaning and he became a suicide fighter, shouting Ibegon's name as his battle cry.<ref name="OL" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''I object!'' I mean, ''come on!'' That wolf-guy wasn't even there!|Han Solo, in the non-[[canon]] story "[[The Emperor's Court]]," on Sivrak testifying about the murder of Greedo|<ref name="TL">{{Tales|14|The Emperor's Court}}</ref>}}
Sivrak first appeared as an unnamed extra in the movie [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> [[Rick Baker]] decided to use off-the-shelf masks to perform some reshoots of the booths in the cantina scenes. He used two different furry wolfman masks. The first one to appear onscreen would be identified as "Wolfman" during the shooting, and later as [[Arleil Schous/Legends|Arleil Schous]], a [[Defel/Legends|Defel]].<ref name="CRC">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> The other mask was called "Hyena-Man" during the production.<ref name="TOY" /> In [[1989]], the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] gave "Hyena-Man" a more detailed identity as Lak Sivrak, the Shistavanen Wolfman.<ref name="CRC" />

Lak Sivrak, the Shistavanen Wolfman, was not mentioned in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization of ''A New Hope'']], beyond a widely generic mention to "creatures with fur" in the cantina.<ref name="ANHnov">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'']]</ref>

In [[1997]], Sivrak was digitally replaced for the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]] of ''A New Hope.'' A detailed puppet later known as [[Ketwol/Legends|Ketwol]] would be seen in his place, leaving Lak's canonicity disputed.<ref name="DK">{{DB|character|ketwol|Ketwol}}</ref> In [[1998]], the first action figure of Sivrak was released, for the fourth yearly update of the series [[Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|''The Power of the Force'']].

Sivrak appears in the non-canon comic ''[[The Emperor's Court]]''. In this comic, Sivrak is a drooling person with dark gray fur, instead of the brown fur he had in the movie; and Dice Ibegon whispers for him. He is one of the witnesses to testify on the murder of Greedo, but Han Solo objects saying that "that wolf-guy wasn't even there." This comic deals with [[Han shot first|the changes]] made for the Special Edition of ''A New Hope,'' including the scene of Greedo's death and the disappearance of Sivrak<ref name="TL" />&mdash;but even then, pre-Special Edition stories in ''[[Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]]'' specified that Sivrak left the cantina before Greedo's death.<ref name="OL" /><ref name="MT" />

''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'' says that Dice Ibegon was a Rebel agent when she first met Sivrak, and then says that Sivrak and Ibegon joined the Alliance together.<ref name="EC" />

The role-playing guide ''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]'' ([[1993]]) includes a text on Sivrak very similar, but not exact, to Sivrak's description in ''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]'' ([[1989]]).<ref name="G1" /><ref name="MT" /> Both books provide role-playing stats for Sivrak, representing him at different moments of his life: The stats in ''The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook'' are higher, because Sivrak's skills have improved with his age.<ref name="CORE">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''</ref> However, in an uncommon situation, Sivrak had lost his knowledge of Medicine at some point after joining the Alliance.<ref name="MT" />

The book ''[[The Star Wars Rules Companion]]'' shows an image of Lak Sivrak without giving any new information. Roleplaying guides ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'' and ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'' list Sivrak's name as one of the example names for Shistavanens.
